own-open.summary: Wake beneath an unfamiliar sky in a woodland clearing. A weathered sign points toward Thornwall. Explore your surroundings and choose your first steps in the Severed Lands.
own-open.title: Rift Awakening

own-open.summary: A broken Guild wagon blocks a forest crossing. Its driver needs help while a hungry Rifthound watches from the treeline.
own-open.title: Last Cart Through

own-open.summary: A Rift-touched boar has made a supply trail impassable. Choose your ground before the hunt becomes a charge.
own-open.title: The Quarry Turns

own-open.summary: A surveyor hangs below a Cairnfields crossing. Clear the approach, then keep the rescue line intact.
own-open.title: Hold the Rope

own-open.summary: A recovered suit of Warden armour wakes during an Athenaeum stocktake. Get the porters out before the storeroom becomes wreckage.
own-open.title: Dead Inventory

own-open.summary: A Lodge trainee owes the town an exhibition. Stand in for two friendly bouts and give the audience something worth remembering.
own-open.title: The Sparring Debt

own-open.summary: A salvage crew is trapped in a Hollows cellar. Open a way in, then bring them out before the district shifts.
own-open.title: No One Left Below

own-open.summary: At a Nexus cartographer's wake, the final chart is missing. A broken cellar latch and a witness's account offer the first leads.
own-open.title: The Cartographer’s Wake

own-open.summary: An amber lamp burns upstairs in a townhouse newly returned to the Hollows. A local scavenger asks for help recovering a family keepsake.
own-open.title: A Light on Breathing Street

own-open.summary: At a Thornwall forge, two unpaid workers present pay chits and a rough sketch of a counting-house. Decide whether and how to help reclaim their wages.
own-open.title: The Honest Thief

own-open.summary: A warning bell fell into an old Warden workhouse after a salvage platform collapsed. Crews offer payment and equipment for its recovery.
own-open.title: The Bell Below

own-open.summary: A Guild supply caravan is overdue in the Verdant Margin. At a roadside post, a courier shows its last known trail and offers a rescue contract.
own-open.title: The Long Way Round

own-open.summary: As Lodge trainee Tavin Bell, begin beside a missing-relic notice and your signed pledge. Quarterkeeper Ysra asks for a Warden survey plate's return and an honest account.
own-open.title: A Debt in Iron

own-open.summary: Two salvage crews claim the same newly returned Hollows storehouse. Rift-touched predators occupy its entrance route, and both crews offer to pay for scouting.
own-open.title: The Scavengers’ Accord

own-open.summary: At a Hollows staging yard, a patron offers a paid trial recovery from a newly returned storehouse. Meet available workers and decide how to approach the job.
own-open.title: The Company of the Lost

own-open.summary: In a Nexus map room, two charts disagree about a Cairnfields approach. A sponsor offers a survey contract and equipment for checking the route.
own-open.title: The Map of Tomorrow
